Exclusive Game Adjustments
1. Inside the coin door is a bracket with three button switches. Set the AUTO-UP/MANUAL-DOWN (center) switch to AUTO-UP. Press the ADVANCE switch twice to display GAME ADJUSTMENTS on the screen.
2. With the AUTO-UP/MANUAL-DOWN switch set to AUTO-UP press the ADVANCE switch twice. The GAME ADJUSTMENTS screen will come up.
3. Move the cursor beside the desired adjustment by using TURBO.
4. STEER to alter the value of any adjustment listed on the screen.
